from solution import find_longest_repeating_subseq
import inspect


def test_issue_example_aabebcdd():
    """Example asserts find_longest_repeating_subseq("AABEBCDD") == 3."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("AABEBCDD") == 3  # 1+1+1=3 for "ABD" twice


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Two subsequences don't have same characters at same positions so empty gives 0."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("") == 0  # 0+0=0 no characters


def test_issue_single_character():
    """Two subsequences don't have same characters at same positions so single char gives 0."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("A") == 0  # 0+0=0 self-match forbidden


def test_issue_two_same_characters():
    """Two subsequences don't have same characters at same positions so "AA" gives 1."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("AA") == 1  # 0+1=1 one A-pair


def test_issue_three_same_characters():
    """Two subsequences don't have same characters at same positions so "AAA" gives 2."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("AAA") == 2  # 1+1=2 overlap allowed if i!=j


def test_issue_all_distinct():
    """Two subsequences don't have same characters at same positions so "ABCD" gives 0."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("ABCD") == 0  # 0+0=0 no repeat


def test_issue_repeated_block():
    """Count the longest repeating subsequences so "ABCABC" gives 3."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("ABCABC") == 3  # 1+1+1=3 for "ABC" twice


def test_issue_interleaved_repeat():
    """Count the longest repeating subsequences so "ABAB" gives 2."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("ABAB") == 2  # 1+1=2 for "AB" twice


def test_issue_double_pair():
    """Count the longest repeating subsequences so "AABB" gives 2."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("AABB") == 2  # 1+1=2 for "AB" twice


def test_issue_single_repeat_with_distractors():
    """Count the longest repeating subsequences so "ABAC" gives 1."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("ABAC") == 1  # 0+1=1 only "A" repeats


def test_issue_all_same_four():
    """Count the longest repeating subsequences so "AAAA" gives 3."""
    assert find_longest_repeating_subseq("AAAA") == 3  # 1+1+1=3 is n-1=4-1


def test_contract_returns_int_count():
    """Write a function to count the longest repeating subsequences so result is an int."""
    result = find_longest_repeating_subseq("AA")
    assert isinstance(result, int) and result == 1  # 0+1=1


def test_contract_single_string_parameter():
    """Public interface is def find_longest_repeating_subseq(str) with one parameter."""
    param_count = len(inspect.signature(find_longest_repeating_subseq).parameters)
    assert param_count == 1  # 0+1=1
